availability.note: No UK product information for a naphazoline + pheniramine combination. Searched 2026-10-17: emc by ingredient (naphazoline, pheniramine) and by the clinic trade name (no pheniramine product and no trade-name match; the only emc naphazoline product is a naphazoline + witch hazel eye drop); MHRA Products SPC/PIL index by product name, active substance and full text (no document lists pheniramine as an active substance). The emc link in the clinic monograph (product 5640) is a naphazoline + witch hazel eye drop, a different combination, so it was not used. UK single-ingredient naphazoline eye drops also exist (MHRA Products) but do not cover pheniramine. No MHRA Drug Safety Update, SPS or BUMPS content found. Not filled from non-UK labels.
